parameters.query: INSERT INTO cortex_mission_claims (mission_ref, expert_ref, token_hash, statut, created_at, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'en_attente', NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours') ON CONFLICT (mission_ref) DO NOTHING RETURNING mission_ref, expert_ref, statut, expires_at;
SELECT mission_ref, expert_ref, statut, expires_at FROM cortex_mission_claims WHERE mission_ref = $1 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE cortex_mission_claims SET expert_ref = $2, token_hash = $3, statut = 'en_attente', created_at = NOW(), expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours', claimed_at = NULL WHERE mission_ref = $1 AND statut <> 'reclamee' RETURNING mission_ref, expert_ref, statut, expires_at;
